raw_response:
This plot is very small, and for my perennial/fruit trees I mostly depend on family work and what inputs I can manage myself. Chemical fertilizer is costly and often comes late here, so on this plot I would rather use a little manure or compost and keep it low-cost. I will not irrigate because I usually depend on the rains, and I will not hire labor for such a small piece of land.
